purpose: Teach: 君主/真空/放射能/被爆/高官/元来/堕落/精霊

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、君主制下の医療事情を医療チームで研究しております
lines.en: Ren, I'd like to tell you about the healthcare research we're conducting with our medical team.
lines.style: Steady opening, measured pace. Clear enunciation. Warm but professional—inviting him into serious conversation without pressure.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 真空パックの医療器具を貴院、活用されているとのこと、先生
lines.en: I understand your hospital uses vacuum-sealed sterilization for your medical equipment, sensei.
lines.style: Quiet curiosity. Leans slightly forward on the question. Careful enunciation—he's testing whether he understands correctly. Genuine interest, not performance.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、放射能事故時の対応訓練を医療チームで行います
lines.en: Yes. We conduct emergency response drills with our medical team, particularly for radiation incidents.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact. No apology in the tone. Steady breath. She's matter-of-fact because this is what her job requires, but there's steadiness underneath—competence speaking.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 被爆地から来られた患者さんを、貴院、丁寧に診ておられますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital takes such careful care of patients from affected areas. That's remarkable, sensei.
lines.style: Soft admiration. Deliberate pace. He's thinking as he speaks—this isn't rehearsed. Small pause before 'remarkable,' like he's choosing the word carefully.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、行政高官への医療相談を医療チームで対応しております
lines.en: Yes. We handle medical consultations with government officials as well. Our team manages those carefully.
lines.style: Measured, professional. A slight weight on 'carefully'—this is delicate work. No elaboration. She trusts him to understand the gravity.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 貴院、元来の小規模クリニックから大規模病院に成長されたんですね、先生
lines.en: So your hospital grew from a small clinic into something much larger. That must have taken real commitment, sensei.
lines.style: Genuine wonder. Slow pace. He's connecting dots—understanding the scale of what she's built. Not flattery, just recognition.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、心の堕落感を訴える患者さんを医療チームでケアします
lines.en: Yes. We also work with patients experiencing spiritual distress or loss of meaning. Our team approaches that with care.
lines.style: Slight softening in the vocal tone. 'Spiritual distress' is said with weight—she's not minimizing this. Calm authority. She means this.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 貴院、伝統的な精霊信仰にも理解を示されますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital shows such understanding toward traditional spiritual beliefs. That's not something you see everywhere, sensei.
lines.style: Appreciative exhale. Slower final phrase. He's seeing something larger about her—her humanity, not just her credentials. Genuine, without over-performing.
